title: Tidewater seed pitch
brief: I need a 10-slide seed pitch deck by Friday for Tidewater, our startup that turns retired electric-vehicle batteries into home energy storage for coastal homes in Croatia. Audience: seed investors in Zagreb. Last time investors said the story wasn't clear, so give it a clear arc: problem, solution, pilot traction, market, business model, team, the ask and use of funds. Facts we can use: a 2025 pilot with 40 homes in Split cut household electricity bills by 31% on average; second-life batteries cost 45% less than new ones; Croatia will retire an estimated 12,000 EV batteries by 2030 (our estimate, so label it); team of six, including two battery engineers from the EV industry; we are raising EUR 1.2M to reach 500 homes by the end of 2027. Anything else (revenue, customer names, market size in euros) stays a bracketed placeholder. Include one native editable chart, speaker notes on every slide, and keep all text editable. Tone: confident, warm, Adriatic.

source.adaptation: Real seed-pitch brief rewritten in the voice of the "Startup founder needing a pitch deck" persona: kept every supplied fact; replaced "two battery engineers from Rimac" with "from the EV industry" (no real company named for fictional people); added the persona's deadline, the "story isn't clear" feedback and the standard arc, the placeholder rule for unsupplied numbers, one editable chart and speaker notes.
